fusions.name: Rap of Order
fusions.desc: A sharp correcting rap that deals 13 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Lesson for the Room
fusions.desc: Levels your staff and looses a bolt that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. If it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Drill Call
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Called Correction
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
